title: An idea becomes a connected system — Physical Data Units

scenes.title: Zero, ruler and series
scenes.purpose: Establish the plain ground, the dashed common zero and the shared unit ruler before any quantity appears.
visuals: Orthographic Three.js ground plate with dashed zero baseline
Unit ruler grows 0→8 with ticks per unit and labels 0/2/4/6/8 plus '1 block = 1'
Series chips IDEA, LINKS, NODES, SYSTEM fade in under the plate

beats.development: Ruler builds from zero; title, subtitle and series chips appear; camera starts its shallow orbit.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system
Same block, same zero: one unit grows into eight.

scenes.title: Build at a constant rule
scenes.purpose: Show that every series is built from identical 1×1×1 blocks, one level every 0.19 s for all stacks at once, so a taller stack only takes longer.
visuals: Equal unit blocks fall 1.6 units onto each stack and land on the same levels at the same time
Chip counts tick up as blocks land: IDEA 1, LINKS 3, NODES 5, SYSTEM 8
SYSTEM uses active #005885; other series use secondary #B9D5DE tones
Orbit continues toward -16° at constant elevation

beats.development: Level 1 lands on all four stacks at once; levels 2–5 follow at the same rate and IDEA stops at 1, LINKS at 3.
NODES stops at 5; SYSTEM keeps stacking to its eighth block, level with the ruler's 8.

scenes.title: Hold the comparison
scenes.purpose: Name the difference and hold the settled comparison with zero and ruler in view.
visuals: Callout leader draws from the top of SYSTEM, then '8× the idea' appears
Orbit eases to rest at -16° by 2.5 s
All blocks, ruler and labels settled

beats.development: Leader line draws, then the callout text fades in.
Settled reading hold of the full comparison.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system
Same block, same zero: one unit grows into eight.

findings: Brisk 0.42 s setup; build runs at one constant level rate so the stacks' different heights read as a time difference too; the orbit finishes by 2.5 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.34–3.0 s hold so the full comparison and callout can be read while settled.
